business.name: Chef & Mixologist
business.description: Chef & Mixologist is a pure vegetarian restaurant and cafe in Sreebhumi, Lake Town, Kolkata. The menu spans North Indian, Chinese and pan-Asian dishes, with Continental, Italian and Mexican favourites, and a long list of mocktails and beverages. There is live music, a private dining room for groups, parking with valet, and wheelchair access. Jain-friendly and kitty-party menus are part of what we do.

entries.title: Live music
entries.subtitle: At the restaurant
entries.body: Dine with live music. Call us or message us on Instagram to ask about the current schedule.

entries.title: Is Chef & Mixologist pure vegetarian?
entries.body: Yes. Everything we serve is vegetarian, and we are Jain-friendly too.

entries.title: Where are you?
entries.body: On the ground floor of the building at 441 Canal Street, off VIP Road, in Sreebhumi, Lake Town, Kolkata 700048.

entries.title: What are your opening hours?
entries.body: We are open every day from 11:00 to 23:00.

entries.title: How do I book a table?
entries.body: Use Book a table on this site, or call us on +91 82400 37583. For groups, kitty parties and celebrations, send a private dining enquiry.

entries.title: Do you have live music?
entries.body: Yes. Call us or message us on Instagram to ask about the current schedule.

entries.title: Is there parking?
entries.body: Yes. Parking is available, with valet.

entries.title: Is the restaurant wheelchair accessible?
entries.body: Yes, there is wheelchair access. Tell us before you visit if you need any other help.

entries.title: Do you have a private dining room?
entries.body: Yes. It suits family gatherings, birthdays and kitty parties. Send a private dining enquiry with your date and number of guests.

entries.title: Do you offer pickup and delivery?
entries.body: Yes. Use Order online to choose pickup or delivery and see the current fee and minimum order.

entries.title: Are children welcome?
entries.body: Yes, children are welcome.

entries.title: Find us
entries.subtitle: Come and sit down. Here is where we are and when we are open.
entries.body:
## Getting here
We are on the ground floor of the building at 441 Canal Street, off VIP Road, in Sreebhumi, Lake Town. Parking with valet is available and the restaurant has wheelchair access.

If you need help finding us, call +91 82400 37583.
